evidence.note: Documents sample-quality variation in diffusion research, but the supplied abstract does not identify the discussed ChatGPT or Grok systems as tested models.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports contemporary ChatGPT producing both successes and errors. It does not establish repeated-request variability and advance unpredictability for the systems under discussion. Research on other diffusion models supplies context but cannot settle those remaining elements.
